title: SuperPlayer
description: This project add ability commands to your server!
body:
# Superplayer Abilities Plugin

Superplayer is a lightweight, performance-focused administration and gameplay enhancement plugin for modern Paper/Spigot servers. It grants players access to four game-changing, visual-heavy tactical abilities, completely managed by a responsive cooldown and custom admin bypass system.

Built entirely upon modern execution methods, all visual elements interact on a client-side basis, ensuring your server remains lag-free while running beautifully.

## Key Features
⚡ Four Custom Player Abilities: A tailored set of tactical powers built to shift the tide of battle, tracking, or resource gathering.

## Available Abilities

### /ability radar
Instantly sweeps a 100-block field around you. If nearby players are detected, a persistent, vertical column of crimson tracker particles highlights their exact spatial layout through solid blocks, blocks, or terrain—visible only to you.

### /ability buff
Instantly channels combat enhancements to your character. Provides exactly 1 minute of high-tier status effects, including Regeneration II, Strength II, Speed II, Resistance II, and Saturation II.

### /ability pull
Harness gravitational pull to control the battlefield. Instantly pulls all living entities (monsters, animals, and enemy players) within a tight 30-block radius directly to your exact spatial coordinates using a clean velocity-vector arc.

### /ability xrayer
Scans a 30-block cube directly around your position for ultra-valuable assets (Diamonds, Emeralds, Gold, Iron, Lapis, and Ancient Debris). Discovered ores are instantly encased in a vivid, color-coded, glowing wireframe outline (Block Displays) piercing directly through the walls for 10 seconds.
